Ethiopian Forces Enter Tigray Town of Adwa

Ethiopian government forces have entered the key Tigray town of Adwa, located near the Eritrean border, following the withdrawal of rebel forces. Witnesses reported the advance, with Ethiopian forces tightening their grip on the region.
